parameters.name: CertificateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the certificate.

You can call the [ListExternalSAMLIdPCertificates](~~341629~~) operation to query the IDs of certificates.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso remove-external-saml-idp-certificate --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --certificate-id idp-c-00dt9gnl7fmjaw9c0000 --region cn-hangzhou
